'''Lanitha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Lanitha was employed as a serving girl in the [[Fungus Pit]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in [[Bashka]], on Ryloth. When the [[heroes of Cularin]] visited the cantina during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Lanitha greeted them and asked them if she could get them anything.
